result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' title in the Popular right now list is clipped, so its last letter is cut off even though there is plenty of horizontal space. The other partially visible items are the right edge of horizontal carousels or content cut by the bottom of the viewport, so they are not reported.

issues.description: The restaurant title in the 'Popular right now' card reads 'Tokumaru Rameı' instead of 'Tokumaru Ramen'. The final 'n' is visibly clipped, leaving a stray vertical stroke. There is ample empty space between the title and the rating, so the text container appears to have a fixed or miscalculated width, or an overflow clip that cuts off the last glyph. This makes the restaurant name look misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Let the title container size to its content or fill the space available before the rating element (e.g., flex: 1 with min-width: 0). Only apply overflow clipping with a proper ellipsis when text actually exceeds the space. Also check that line-height and padding don't clip glyphs.
